description: Bypass login via SQL comment truncation (administrator'--). Extracts CSRF token from form, then POSTs with SQLi in the username field. The -- comment truncates the password check. Returns csrf_extracted, status_code, response_length, headers, likely_bypass.

csrf_field.description: Name of the CSRF token field in the form

password_field.description: Name of the password form field

username.description: Target username to bypass auth for, e.g. 'administrator'

username_field.description: Name of the username form field

name: sqli_login_bypass
